[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]💚 Alex HD Portraits [b]By Hemptress[/b]
Give Pelican Town's resident jock the glow-up he deserves.
[b]Alex HD Portraits[/b] replaces Alex's original character portraits with a detailed, semi-realistic HD redesign while keeping him recognizable, lore-friendly, and unmistakably Alex.
His new look leans into his confident athlete aesthetic with a slightly more mature appearance, cleaner facial structure, expressive eyes, fuller features, and a polished version of his classic Stardew hairstyle.
Basically:
Same Alex. But hotter. 💚
[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]💚 A MORE MATURE ALEX
Alex's portrait has been redesigned to make him appear slightly older and more refined while preserving his youthful personality.
His facial proportions have been adjusted with:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A stronger but natural jaw[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fuller upper and lower lips[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]More defined brows[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Longer, thicker lashes[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]More expressive eyes[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Cleaner facial anatomy[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A more polished interpretation of his original hairstyle[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The result is a version of Alex that feels more like a young adult athlete while still fitting naturally into Stardew Valley.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🎭 EXPRESSIVE PORTRAITS
Alex's expressions have been redrawn with an emphasis on making his emotions immediately readable during dialogue.
Whether he's:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Smiling[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Flirting[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Surprised[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Annoyed[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Embarrassed[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Upset[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Confident[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Vulnerable[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]...the updated portraits give his conversations a little more personality and emotional weight.
Especially once those heart events start hitting.
👀
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🎨 MY HD PORTRAIT STYLE
This mod is part of my growing collection of [b]Stardew Valley HD Portraits[/b].
My portrait redesigns focus on:
✦ Recognizable characters
I try to preserve the visual identity and personality of the original NPC.
✦ Enhanced anatomy
Cleaner faces, stronger silhouettes, and proportions.
✦ Expressive features
Eyes, brows, mouths, and poses are designed to communicate emotion clearly.
✦ Romantic character design
Because if Stardew is going to let us marry half the town, they might as well look yummified while we're doing it.[/color]
